name: Liliana, Untouched by Death
oracle_text:
+1: Mill three cards. If at least one Zombie card is milled this way, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
−2: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of Zombies you control.
−3: You may cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
blocked_sentences: −3: You may cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.

needs.what: a turn-long permission to cast any number of spells matching a filter (subtypes Zombie) from your own graveyard at their printed cost, with no per-turn cap and no exile-instead rider -- e.g. letting grant_graveyard_cast accept an unmetered spec when the grant is itself bounded to this turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_graveyard_cast is exactly the shape (a this-turn GraveyardCastGrant that turn.py drops at end of turn, reading affects_spells), but the loader refuses it unless it carries 'max_per_turn' or 'grants_flashback'. Liliana prints neither: adding max_per_turn caps a sentence that has no cap, and grants_flashback exiles spells the card lets go back to the graveyard. grant_playable snapshots only the cards in the graveyard now, missing Zombies that land there later in the turn, and the cast_from_graveyard static is read off a permanent and would outlive 'this turn'.
